item.text: {"search_note":"I found good directional evidence for macro indicators because IMF/World Bank reporting is frequent and specific. I found weaker direct evidence for causal attribution to Sisi personally on household welfare, because most available indicators are program-level, lagged, or externally supervised. For non-economic outcomes, the available evidence is clearer and mostly negative: rights, protest tolerance, refugee treatment, and political openness did not improve in a way that matches a broad “outcomes improved” claim.","evidence":[{"title":"IMF Executive Board Completes the Third Review of the Extended Arrangement Under the Extended Fund Facility for Egypt","publisher":"IMF","date":"Jul. 29, 2024","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/29/pr24293-egypt-imf-exec-board-completes-3rd-rev-extended-arr-eff","summary":"Macro stabilization showed real short-run improvement: inflation was easing, FX shortages had been eliminated, fiscal targets were met, and social spending was supposed to be protected. This is the clearest evidence that at least one key outcome moved in the direction of the regime’s stated stabilization goals.","question_ids":["8B.7","8B.6"]},{"title":"IMF Reaches Agreement on the 3rd Review of the EFF","publisher":"IMF","date":"Jun. 6, 2024","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/06/06/pr-24208-egypt-imf-reaches-agreement-on-the-3rd-review-of-the-eff","summary":"The IMF said the reform program remained on track, with a flexible exchange rate, tighter macro policy, and a stated push toward private-sector-led growth and fiscal space for health and education. That supports a limited “directionally positive” reading for the economic file, though it is still stabilization under external supervision.","question_ids":["8B.7","8B.6"]},{"title":"Promoting Inclusive Human Capital Development and Building Resilience in Egypt Through Cash Transfer Programs","publisher":"World Bank Group","date":"May 28, 2024","url":"https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2024/05/28/promoting-inclusive-human-capital-development-and-building-resilience-in-egypt-through-cash-transfer-programs","summary":"Takaful and Karama was described as institutionalized, well-targeted, and administratively disciplined, with a grievance mechanism, dynamic registry, and a benefit increase to offset inflation. This is strong positive evidence that at least some welfare outcomes moved in the intended direction.","question_ids":["8B.7","8B.6"]},{"title":"Egypt’s Growth Slows to 2.8 Percent in FY24","publisher":"World Bank","date":"Apr. 3, 2024","url":"https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099759004052420744","summary":"Growth fell to 2.8 percent in FY24 because real incomes were eroded by macro imbalances and global shocks. This is strong counterevidence that broader household welfare had not yet improved in practice, even if stabilization was underway.","question_ids":["8B.7"]},{"title":"Egypt Halt Crackdown on People Voicing Concerns Over Economic Crisis","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"May 13, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/egypt-halt-crackdown-on-people-voicing-concerns-over-economic-crisis/","summary":"Instead of translating economic stress into visible correction, the state arrested protesters, striking workers, and online critics. That is negative outcome evidence for the claim that the year’s economic deterioration was being managed in a way that improved ordinary people’s lived experience.","question_ids":["8B.7","8B.6","8B.8"]},{"title":"Egypt: More Than 100 Arbitrarily Detained Over Calls for Anti-Government Protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"Jul. 18, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/07/egypt-more-than-100-arbitrarily-detained-over-calls-for-anti-government-protests/","summary":"Security forces detained 119 people over protest calls tied to price hikes and power cuts, using incommunicado detention and broad security charges. That is strong evidence that worsening living conditions were producing coercive state responses, not visible improvement.","question_ids":["8B.7","8B.6","8B.8"]},{"title":"Egypt: Education Restricted for Refugees","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"Dec. 2, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/egypt-education-restricted-for-refugees","summary":"Tens of thousands of refugee and asylum-seeking children were out of school because of residency barriers, costs, discrimination, and limited free public education. This is strong evidence that vulnerable-group access outcomes moved in the wrong direction.","question_ids":["8B.7","8B.6","8B.8"]},{"title":"Egypt: Authorities Must End Campaign of Mass Arrests and Forced Returns of Sudanese Refugees","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"Jun. 19, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/06/egypt-authorities-must-end-campaign-of-mass-arrests-and-forced-returns-of-sudanese-refugees/","summary":"Border police and Border Guard Forces mass-arrested Sudanese refugees, held women, men, and children in cruel conditions, and forcibly returned them without asylum access. That is direct contrary evidence on whether outcomes improved for a clearly vulnerable population.","question_ids":["8B.7","8B.6","8B.8"]},{"title":"Egypt: Civic Space Under Siege","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"Jan. 11, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/egypt-civic-space-under-siege","summary":"The pre-election environment still featured curtailed free expression and assembly, with arrests and intimidation used to stymie meaningful competition. That is negative outcome evidence for any claim that the political environment became more open or responsive in 2024.","question_ids":["8B.7","8B.6"]},{"title":"Egypt: Court Punishes Activists Challenging al-Sisi","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"Feb. 8, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/02/08/egypt-court-punishes-activists-challenging-al-sisi","summary":"The sentencing and election ban for Tantawy and supporters show the political field remained closed, not moving toward the competitive environment Sisi publicly described.","question_ids":["8B.7","8B.6","8B.8"]}]}
